name: Mist Resonance Harmonize: after a Melody, allies assign combat damage with their life stat
notes: A Tamer champion (WATER lineage) activates Steady Verse (a Melody) and then Mist Resonance. Harmonize is on, so the Dungeon Guide (power 1, life 3, +1 LIFE from Mist Resonance = 4) assigns 4 combat damage to the opposing champion instead of 1.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] Harmonize -- If you've activated a Melody card this turn, allies you control assign damage with their life stat instead of power stat until end of turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Mist Resonance's Harmonize clause (allies assign damage with life instead of power) was not implemented at all.
